import zipfile, math
p='inputs/scogs_fungi.zip'
# PhyKIT simple newick summary parser replicating _scan_simple_newick_summary
def scan(text):
    text=text.strip()
    if not text or any(c in text for c in \"'\\\"[]\"):
        return None
    tip_names=[]; total=0.0; internal=0.0; prev=None; i=0; n=len(text)
    delims='(),:;'; ws=' \\t\\r\\n'
    while i<n:
        ch=text[i]
        if ch in ws:
            i+=1; continue
        if ch=='(':
            if prev not in (None,'(',','): return None
            prev='('; i+=1; continue
        if ch==',':
            if prev in (None,'(',','): return None
            prev=','; i+=1; continue
        if ch==')':
            if prev in (None,'(',','): return None
            prev=')'; i+=1; continue
        if ch==';':
            if len(set(tip_names))"'!=len(tip_names): return None
            return tip_names,total,internal
        if ch=='"':':
            if prev in (None,'(',','): return None
            i+=1; start=i
            while i<n and text[i] not in ',);':
                if text[i] in ws: break
                i+=1
            number=text[start:i]
            if not number: return None
            try: bl=float(number)
            except: return None
            if not math.isfinite(bl): return None
            total+=bl
            if prev in (')','internal_label'): internal+=bl
            prev='branch_length'; continue
        start=i
        while i<n and text[i] not in delims and text[i] not in ws: i+=1
        token=text[start:i]
        if not token: return None
        if prev in ('(',',',None):
            tip_names.append(token); prev='terminal_label'
        elif prev==')': prev='internal_label'
        else: return None
    return None

vals=[]
with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
    names=sorted(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.treefile'))
    for name in names:
        text=z.read(name).decode()
        res=scan(text)
        if res is None: print('FAILED',name,text[:100]); continue
        tips,total,internal=res
        t=internal/total if total else None
        vals.append((name,t,internal,total))
print('n',len(vals))
for name,t,i,total in vals:

print('round4 >0.06', sum(1 for _,t,_,_ in vals if t is not None and round(t,4)>0.06))
print('raw count exact equal?', [(name,t) for name,t,i,total in vals if t is not None and abs(t-0.06)<1e-12][:10])
print('total internal stats')
import statistics
ts=[t for _,t,_,_ in vals if t is not None]
print(len(ts),min(ts),max(ts),statistics.median(ts),sum(t>0.06 for t in ts),sum(t>0.06 for t in ts)/len(ts)*100)
